acceptanceCriteria: Decision 0375's RELEASE-NOTES citations are anchored so an insertion above them does not break line-citations-check, verified by an insertion test.
body: Lanes that insert release notes above docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md line ~351 shift the two line citations in decision 0375, failing line-citations-check (seen in #1061). Expected: a citation anchor stable under insertions above it.
title: decision 0375 RELEASE-NOTES line citations break whenever release notes are inserted above them
